member: Kofi — Structural Enclosure and Low-Cost Fabrication Specialist
message:
Surya, Lena, Farah, the full store sits on the raised reinforced concrete plinth (C10), where plinth means flat concrete base spreading load to soil. Produce plus box weigh little more than a small car on patio slab. Floor load 2.45 kPa per floor loading (E48) and soil pressure 2.51 kPa per soil pressure (E47), far below 50 kPa minimum soil value per slab guide (E43), sane against one person per square metre.

The box stays light and repairable with the bolted galvanized steel angle support frame (C11), where Polyurethane (PU) means rigid foam insulation and Photovoltaic (PV) means solar panels. Thin steel corners plus foam panels carry wind while separate ground rack keeps sun panels off cold roof, and side racks stand free on plinth so panels carry no crate load. Panels 10 to 14 kg per square metre per 100 mm PU panel (E37) and angle 1.80 kg per metre per 40 mm x 40 mm x 3 mm angle (E40), for the 2.00 by 2.00 by 2.20 m 1 tonne box per cooling load (E24), framed as shown per structure sketch (E49).

Daily access fits people and crates through the single 900 mm insulated hinged door (C12). Low racks stacked three high keep lifts below shoulder height with air gaps for cleaning. 900 mm door and 100 mm wall gap per interior plan (E36), sane against household doorway. Not ready, because night energy cover with Surya and chiller pull-down with Lena are still open.
